added.name: Turks and Caicos Parliament Webcasts
added.scope: The current institutional constitutional overview identifies substantive legislation through the House and Governor assent, approval of public expenditure, government scrutiny and committees. This is the territorial Parliament, not a municipal council. The official site uses Parliament while retaining House of Assembly terminology in its constitutional explanation.

added.terms: The website terms explicitly permit sharing public-page links and personal, educational or non-commercial viewing, downloads and printing. Commercial reproduction or distribution requires written permission. This website-content clause does not establish a separate licence to extract, embed or retransmit provider video.
added.note: The current official Parliament site and the legacy gov.tc/hoa/videos route both designate @TCIParliament. A 16 October 2026 sitting decoded at 640x360. The 22 October event was labelled Live and decoded at 854x480 with advancing playback, but the sampled position was behind the live edge; treat this as provider-live-event/DVR validation, not proof of real-time chamber activity. Committee-room coverage remains unverified.

held_followup.authority_note: Official reprint dated 13 June 2022: Article 39 gives Parliament general Act-making powers; Article 13 provides parliamentary confidence/accountability; Articles 70-71 establish appropriation and public expenditure audit scrutiny. Read with the Parliament-hosted text consolidation and current MFAT free-association guidance. The dated reprint is not represented as a verified 2026 consolidation. This is the national Parliament of a self-governing associated state, not a New Zealand province or the House of Ariki.
held_followup.finding: Parliament TV explicitly designates Facebook broadcasts and replays. Its sampled 26 May 2022 replay link reports video unavailable. The public Facebook Videos listing opens but offers old interviews and promotional material; that is not validated current parliamentary proceedings. The empty /live page and old YouTube archive remain unresolved.
held_followup.next_action: Locate a recent official sitting replay or current broadcast route; validate public playback without login. Authority review is resolved positively; do not substitute youth parliament or promotional interviews for proceedings.

held_followup.authority_note: Signed RA12317, approved 25 March 2026, was read visually: section 2 provides BTA holdover until elected successors qualify; section 6 sets assumption at noon on 30 October 2026. The last sitting on 21 October does not by itself establish expiry of office. The Supreme Court finality notice of 26 November 2024 excludes Sulu from BARMM.
held_followup.finding: Institutional transition timing is now clearer from the signed election law, rather than conflicting indexed article summaries. The detailed 22 October Parliament news page returned a human-verification challenge and was not bypassed. Natural Earth still labels its provinces ARMM, includes Sulu and lacks the Special Geographic Area boundary, so it cannot be used unmodified for a current BARMM outline.
held_followup.next_action: Obtain a current licensed boundary covering the correct constituent provinces, Cotabato City and Special Geographic Area while excluding Sulu. Verify current post-transition official viewing ownership and published source conditions before promotion.

held_followup.authority_note: The earlier positive Statute articles 30-31 authority assessment stands.
held_followup.finding: Official RTV reporting identifies live sittings on RTV1, and its public annual report describes broadcast coverage of provincial assembly sittings. This resolves the likely broadcaster. Both normal hostnames fail with an HTTP/2 protocol error here; an HTTP/1.1 retry was refused. The assembly Video destination still does not establish a dedicated proceedings service. News clips alone do not validate a recurring parliamentary archive.
held_followup.next_action: Open RTV1 during an announced sitting or locate the broadcaster full-sitting archive and validate playback and its public source conditions. Do not promote the general entertainment/news channel as a dedicated always-on parliament feed.
